p: The cat is under the bed.

p: I always get up at seven.

p: The telephone was invented by Bell.

r: 태양 에너지를 더 많이 모으는 기기

p: Citizens have the right to vote.

p: Not every source you find online is reliable.

사실은 확인될 수 있다는 점에서 의견과 다르다.

a shark swimming on a flooded highway라고 했어요.

h3-2.passage: Some people argue that homework should be banned because it causes stress. The author concedes that too much homework can be harmful.
